_comment: THE BATTERY IS GUARANTEED, in its own single-entry teaching pool - the washing
machine's shape, for the washing machine's reason. A smoke detector is a battery, a
plastic shell and a speck of americium, so the battery is not a lottery prize in it;
it is the object's whole content.
This is the KNOWLEDGE route. The battery is also found loose in household pulls, so a
player who has never seen the radioactive dump can still build a vacuum; what the
detector buys is the blueprint, which is what turns a lucky find into a supply.

pools._comment: The shell and the sounder. Small object, small carcass.
